name: Pizza Party (Weston Park)
description:
Our annual, BIGGEST fresher’s week event. Free Pizza 🍕 with membership!! (we might have a guest to give our more freebies)

We will be hosting games for students to talk to one another. Super chill event, make sure to bring your picnic mats!

description: A chill evening with Hallam CompSoc - a great chance to meet other computer scientists in the city and take a mid-week break!

name: Python GIAG
description: Give Python a Go! Get a head start by learning Python’s fundamentals along with a live coding session and Kahoot quiz. No prior programming experience needed but bring your laptops to the session if you can.

name: White T-Shirt Barcrawl
description:
CompSoc's highly-anticipated annual White T-Shirt barcrawl! Get a branded CompSoc T-Shirt for £6.50! You can collect T-shirts on the day either at lunchtime or during predrinks at Steelworks on the day!
Route:
• Steelworks 7:45
• Grappa 8:30
• Molly Malones 9:10
• WSL 10:00
• Steinhaus 10:40
• Corp 11:30

name: DYSO: Video game Barcrawl
description: A CompSoc barcrawl that finishes at Foundry for Dance Your Socs Off (DYSO) - a club night for all the university societies! The theme is “Game Over” so feel free to bring your friends and dress up as a video game character! We will be selling tickets for DYSO - there are ONLY 20 so make sure to get them quick!
